# readme-score

> Score a README on ten documented checks: title, summary, install and usage sections, tagged code blocks, license, placeholders, relative links, length and image alt text. Python package `readme_score`, MIT licensed. Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): testing policy
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): parsing approach
